0022600223.text: The Brooklyn Nets, 2-8 and 13th in the East, visit the New Orleans Pelicans, who are 4-6 and 11th in the West, in the Nets' 11th game of the season. Brooklyn has lost its last two games and is 1-5 on the road, while New Orleans has also lost its last two and is 3-3 at home. Egor Demin is out for Brooklyn with a leg bruise, Mikel Brown Jr. is day-to-day with a rest-related game-time decision (he averages 12.9 points and 23.2 minutes per game), and Yves Missi is out for New Orleans with a knee bruise.
